protocol_notes: The NWS CloudGIS directory documents public-cloud OGC WMS, WFS, and WCS services.
The GeoServer directory documents current WFS/WMS layers and publishes GetCapabilities links.
Service and layer names can change; re-check GetCapabilities and service notices before operational release.
Map overlays are situational-awareness visualization only and must not be treated as a hydraulic simulation, survey, or regulatory flood boundary.
The NWS radar FAQ defines CREF.QCD as maximum reflectivity within the radar volume (dBZ), not rainfall accumulation.
Rainfall accumulation products such as BOHA (one-hour) and BDSA (storm-total) are distinct estimates and must not be conflated with reflectivity.
The radar FAQ notes that a blank radar image may indicate a radar outage; overlay health must be visible and must not be interpreted as no hazard.

layers.title: NWS short-fuse warnings
layers.purpose: Operational warning context, including flash-flood and severe-weather warnings.

layers.title: MRMS CONUS composite reflectivity (CREF QCD)
layers.purpose: Weather radar context; not a precipitation accumulation or flood-inundation product.

future_products.title: MRMS quantitative precipitation estimates
future_products.purpose: Radar-only quantitative precipitation estimate mosaics in inches for 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48, and 72 hour windows at approximately 1 km; service metadata says not time-enabled.

future_products.title: One-hour and storm-total precipitation accumulation
future_products.purpose: Potential context/forcing inputs; not equivalent to radar reflectivity and not automatically suitable for hydraulic boundary conditions.

precipitation_estimate_service.title: NWS MRMS quantitative precipitation estimates
precipitation_estimate_service.temporal_semantics: Service is documented as not time-enabled; available mosaics represent fixed accumulation windows and are not a time series.
precipitation_estimate_service.source_semantics: Radar-only MRMS/Q3 quantitative precipitation estimates; not gauge-corrected by this service description.
release_requirements: Inspect service metadata and raster-function/rendering-rule names at runtime.
Record raster selection, accumulation window, retrieval time, units, nodata handling, and data coverage.
Validate an image or raster sample for the Tri-State region before presenting values.
Do not use as hydraulic model forcing until temporal alignment, missing-data handling, and hydrologic validation are implemented.
